TAOM reference

Troop Rosters of Middle-earth

Every troop in troops_*.xml with every battle equipment set, each slot priced. Generated 2026-09-21 13:48 by tools/generate_troop_roster_page.py from the live install; damage and DPS are simulated from the crafting pieces by tools/melee_damage.py, since the engine stores neither.

858troops
16kingdom files
2533battle sets
850carry a melee weapon
0slots naming an unknown item

Tier is the engine's clamp(ceil((level-5)/5), 0, 10), the number the ladders key on. Armour on a troop is the average across its battle sets of the sum of head, body, arm and leg armour on every worn piece, the way the validator scores an upgrade; each set shows its own total.

weapon shows swing/thrust displayed damage and sustained dps from the mode that hits hardest. ranged is the launcher's thrust_damage. shield is hit points. armour is the piece's total, then per attribute (h head, b body, a arm, l leg).
